meals.name: Cuban mojo pork loin with garlicky black beans and rice
steps: Make the mojo: juice of 1 orange and 2 limes, 6 minced garlic cloves, 3 Tbsp olive oil, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano, 1½ tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Pour half over a 2½ lb pork loin and marinate 30 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Roast the pork on a foil-lined pan at 400°F for 45–55 minutes, until it reads 145°F in the center. Rest 10 minutes, then slice thin and spoon the reserved mojo over the slices.

Meanwhile cook 1½ cups rice. In a saucepan, soften ½ diced onion and 2 minced garlic cloves in 1 Tbsp oil, add 2 drained cans of black beans, ½ tsp cumin, a bay leaf and ½ cup water; simmer 10 minutes and finish with a squeeze of lime.
Serve the pork over rice with the beans alongside.

meals.name: Smoky brown-sugar BBQ drumsticks with maple-roasted acorn squash
steps: Rub 4 lb drumsticks with 1 Tbsp oil and a mix of 2 Tbsp brown sugar, 1 Tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp chili powder, 1½ tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper.

Bake on a rack over a lined sheet pan at 425°F for 35 minutes. Stir together ½ cup ketchup, 2 Tbsp honey, 1 Tbsp cider vinegar and 1 tsp Worcestershire; brush over the chicken and bake 10–15 minutes more, until 165°F (drumsticks are juiciest closer to 175°F).
While the chicken bakes, halve 2 acorn squash, scoop the seeds, cut into wedges, toss with 1 Tbsp oil, salt and pepper and roast on a second pan at 425°F for 25 minutes.
Melt 2 Tbsp butter with 2 Tbsp maple syrup and a pinch of chili powder, brush over the squash and roast 5 minutes more until caramelized.

meals.name: Lemon-garlic shrimp scampi linguine with toasted sourdough
steps: Cook 12 oz linguine in well-salted water; reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining. Pat 1½ lb peeled jumbo shrimp dry and season with ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper.
In a large skillet, heat 2 Tbsp olive oil and 2 Tbsp butter over medium-high. Cook the shrimp 1–2 minutes per side until pink and opaque (145°F); move to a plate.
Lower the heat, add 2 Tbsp butter, 6 sliced garlic cloves and ½ tsp red pepper flakes; cook 1 minute. Add ½ cup broth or white wine, the zest and juice of 1 lemon, and simmer 2 minutes.
Toss in the pasta, shrimp, ½ cup grated Parmesan, a chopped handful of parsley and splashes of pasta water until glossy. Serve with 4 slices of toasted sourdough for the sauce.

meals.name: Sheet-pan chicken tikka with charred onions, rice and cucumber raita
steps: Mix 1 cup plain Greek yogurt, 2 Tbsp oil, 2 Tbsp lemon juice, 4 grated garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp grated ginger (or 1 tsp ground), 1 Tbsp garam masala or curry powder, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp chili powder and 1½ tsp salt. Coat 2½ lb chicken breast cut into 1½-inch chunks; marinate 30 minutes or up to a day.
Spread the chicken and 2 onions cut in wedges on a lined sheet pan. Roast at 450°F for 18–22 minutes, then broil 2–3 minutes for charred edges, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Meanwhile cook 1½ cups rice. Stir together ½ cup Greek yogurt, ½ grated cucumber (squeezed dry), a pinch of cumin, salt and chopped cilantro for the raita.
Serve the chicken and onions over rice with raita and more cilantro.

meals.name: Three-cheese baked ziti with garlicky red sauce (meatless)
steps: Make the sauce: warm 2 Tbsp olive oil with 5 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp Italian seasoning and ½ tsp red pepper flakes for 1 minute. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt; simmer 15 minutes.
Boil 1 lb ziti 2 minutes less than the package says; drain. Mix the ricotta with 1 egg, ¼ cup Parmesan, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper.

Toss the pasta with two-thirds of the sauce. In a 9x13 dish, layer half the pasta, dollops of the ricotta mix and half the shredded mozzarella; repeat, then top with the remaining sauce and mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes, uncover and bake 15 minutes more until bubbly and browned. Rest 10 minutes and top with torn basil.

meals.name: Chili-lime beef tacos with quick-pickled onions and avocado crema
steps: Quick-pickle 1 thinly sliced red onion in ½ cup vinegar, ½ cup hot water, 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp salt for at least 15 minutes.

Brown 1½ lb ground beef in 1 tsp oil over medium-high, breaking it up, until no pink remains (160°F); drain most of the fat. Stir in 1 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp oregano, 1 Tbsp tomato paste, ½ tsp salt and ⅓ cup water; simmer 5 minutes and finish with the juice of 1 lime.
Blend or mash 2 avocados with ½ cup sour cream, the juice of 1 lime, a pinch of salt and a little cilantro until smooth.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet and fill with beef, shredded cheese, pickled onions, avocado crema and cilantro.

meals.name: Greek lemon-oregano chicken thighs with crispy potatoes and olives
steps: Whisk ¼ cup olive oil, the zest and juice of 2 lemons, 5 minced garlic cloves, 1 Tbsp oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp Dijon, 1½ tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Toss 2½ lb boneless thighs in half of it.
Cut 3 lb russet potatoes into wedges and toss with the rest of the marinade on a large sheet pan. Roast at 425°F for 20 minutes.

Nestle the chicken among the potatoes, scatter ½ cup halved Kalamata olives and pour ¼ cup broth into the pan. Roast 25–30 minutes more, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the potatoes are crisp at the edges.
Squeeze over any extra lemon and spoon the pan juices on top before serving.

meals.name: Homemade Philly-style cheesesteaks with sweet fried onions and provolone
steps: Freeze 1½ lb strip steak for 30 minutes, then trim the fat and slice it paper-thin across the grain.
Cook 2 thinly sliced onions (and the pepper, if using) in 1 Tbsp oil and 1 Tbsp butter with a pinch of salt over medium heat for 12–15 minutes until soft and golden; set aside.

Raise the heat to high, add 1 Tbsp oil and the steak in batches. Season with ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper, ½ tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp Worcestershire; sear and chop with a spatula 2–3 minutes until just browned.

Divide the steak and onions into 4 piles in the pan, lay 1–2 slices of provolone over each and cover for 1 minute to melt. Scoop each pile into a split, toasted hoagie roll and add cherry peppers if you like.
